mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points in a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE increases > 0.5pp in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% year-over-year signals a weakening demand in the housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST YoY < -10%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% month-over-month signals a strong supply-side response, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when INDPRO MoM > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a loosening monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS decreases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 in a month signals strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when PAYEMS increases > 200,000.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in real GDP (GDPC1) and a decrease in retail sales (RSAFS) signals a shift in consumer spending patterns, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 increases and RSAFS decreases.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and increasing consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) signals tightening monetary conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.
